label: H.R. 2987
title: CEASE Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

summary: Capping Excessive Awarding of SBLC Entrants Act or the CEASE Act This bill limits the number of for-profit small business lending companies that are authorized make 7(a) loans to not more than 16 at any time.
summary_short: Capping Excessive Awarding of SBLC Entrants Act or the CEASE Act This bill limits the number of for-profit small business lending companies that are authorized make 7(a) loans to not more than 16 at any time.
